paper_metadata.title: Copper alloying to enhance the mechanical properties and oxidation resistance of ductile refractory high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) are highly valued for their excellent high-temperature properties, and the enhancement of their room-temperature strength-plasticity matching and oxidation resistance is crucial for their processing and applications.

The (Ti40Nb40Ta10Zr10)100-xCux (x = 0, 1, 2 at%, named Cu0, Cu1, Cu2, respectively) RHEAs ingots were prepared by vacuum arc melting furnace in argon atmosphere using high-purity (99.95 wt%) Ti, Zr, Nb, Ta and Cu.
